nodes.label: The Shape — A Cylinder Over the Transfer
nodes.rationale: The base is q, the fibre is A(q) x B(q), and the cross-sections 165/330/345/136 are the profile computed rather than drawn; the name is 'over' and not 'graded by' because nu grades every chain of Lambda but grades Lambda itself nowhere.

nodes.label: Orientability — Bipartite Sign Structure, Not a Moebius Band
nodes.rationale: A bipartite structure can never produce an odd number of orientation reversals, and both routes to a Moebius band are closed — a non-monotone quantity has undefined edges rather than reversing ones, and a nu-independent quantity has no edge — so this is a reason rather than an absence of evidence.

nodes.label: The Fibres Are Two-Body, Separating on the Coupling
nodes.rationale: As a bare product it fails, 2,244 against 976, because the ends are coupled twice over by q <= k and g <= q; conditioned on the coupling they separate exactly, which is how a two-body problem separates into centre-of-mass and relative motion with q as the conserved coupling.

nodes.label: What the Fibre Table Says — Pareto Frontier and Most-Probable Transfer
Every Cross-Section Is Itself Closed (a new invariant)
nodes.rationale: E(A_q) = E(B_q) = 0 for every q does not follow from E(Lambda) = 0, since a closed index could in principle have defective slices that cancel in the total; here none do, so the cylinder's every cross-section satisfies the book's own law.

nodes.label: Completeness and Predictiveness Are Alternatives
nodes.rationale: Lambda is a property of the hydrogenic limit and the quantum defect is the entire remainder, so prediction lives only in the remainder; a complete index has nothing to predict because the cells it could propose are exactly those its structure admits and its extension denies — for Lambda, the empty set.

nodes.label: The Ninth Axis 2S' <= g — An Axis the Index Did Not Carry
nodes.rationale: Never a closure defect, since the reconstruction cannot see a coordinate never supplied; the asymmetry between A_q carrying 2S and B_q carrying none is what made it visible, and it was built by the identical rule — the target's spin bounded by the target's capacity. Exact vector coupling later confirmed the bound and showed it is not tight.
